name: before-after-wipe
title: Before After Wipe
description: Two panels labelled Sebelum and Sesudah. A divider handle sweeps from the before side to the after side and settles near the middle while the two labels swap emphasis as it passes. The panels are drawn placeholders (two tones and a simple jar) or your own two images.
useWhen: Showing a result: a cleaned, repaired, restyled or re-packaged thing next to how it was.
Laundry, repair, makeover or packaging-upgrade shops.
avoidWhen: More than two states: use split-screen-compare for a list of reasons.
The two images are different shapes: crop them to the same frame first.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Images
variables.description: Optional: two image URLs, before then after, separated by a comma or a new line. Empty draws the placeholders.

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: The After pill: the one accent.

variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.
